retrospective_recomputed.method: Recomputed read-only from 08 sector_year_chamber and 02 seat_calls with the formulas of Codex election_descriptive_check.py; compared as CSV text (exact).

verification.method: Every imported cell read back with openpyxl and compared with its CSV text: empty -> empty cell; text -> identical string; integer -> str(value) identical; decimal -> repr(value) identical. JSON sheets: every leaf row compared, then the JSON rebuilt from the rows and compared with the file: equal as an object, and json.dumps(indent=2) with CRLF newlines reproduces the file text exactly.

number_storage: Numbers stored only in the declared numeric columns (numeric_columns). openpyxl 3.1.5 writes floats with %.16g, which can alter doubles that need 17 significant digits; the build writes floats with Python repr instead (shortest exact round trip) by replacing openpyxl.cell._writer.safe_string in-process. The read-back check proves every value.
